name: Benzoic acid
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: Tmin raised to the triple point 395.45 K (ChemSep: 394.65 K). A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 122.1213 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 395.45-751.00 K
source.chain: CoolProp 8.0.0: fluid not included; ChemSep, as proposal 0008 sets for the components that are not CoolProp fluids (checked against the NIST WebBook where it has data: vapour pressure)
